payload.rationale: ICEA P-32-382, IEEE 242 (Buff Book Sec 9.3), and NEC 110.10 require power conductors to thermally withstand available short-circuit currents until upstream protective devices clear. This verifier implements the closed-form adiabatic thermodynamic formulation for copper and aluminum conductors across thermoplastic and thermoset insulation systems, checking DCR, required cross-sectional area, allowable clearing time, and peak fault temperature.
